checkpoints.description: [1/3] Design and implement deterministic hypothesis generation in lattice.analysis

impact_assessment.why: Systematically translate evidence matrix coverage gaps and contradiction clusters into structured, testable scientific hypotheses for researchers and autonomous AI agents
impact_assessment.benefits: Closes the scientific discovery loop from evidence synthesis to next-experiment design with explicit independent/dependent variables and recommended study types
impact_assessment.risks: Vague or ungrounded hypotheses without clear variable extraction
impact_assessment.mitigation: Extract variables directly from opposing claim phrases and question prompts using deterministic keyword heuristic templates; zero hallucinated provenance

checkpoints.description: checklists: passed. Delivered propose_hypotheses in analysis, api, mcp, client, and hypothesize CLI command. Verified 213/213 unit tests and 25/25 dogfood steps.

checklists: passed. Delivered Proposed Hypotheses card in Web Research Studio with GET /api/hypothesize, loadHypotheses() JS, and matrix integration. Verified UI guard, 214/214 tests, 25/25 dogfood steps.
Task 'lattice-hypothesize-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Design and implement CSL-JSON bibliography parser in lattice.ingest

impact_assessment.why: Enable researchers and agents to ingest universal CSL-JSON citation bibliographies from Zotero, Mendeley, and Crossref directly into the Lattice evidence graph
impact_assessment.benefits: Expands interoperability to the predominant JSON reference format with zero third-party dependencies, preserving all metadata and study types
impact_assessment.risks: Malformed JSON payloads or missing author/date fields
impact_assessment.mitigation: Robust defensive normalization for date-parts, author arrays/literals, and study type fallback inference

[1/3] Design and integrate Visual Controls in Research Studio: edge filters, layout toggle, SVG export, and CSL-JSON paste ingestion

impact_assessment.why: provide interactive visual graph filtering, layout switching, direct SVG download, and CSL-JSON web paste ingestion
impact_assessment.benefits: enables direct visual exploration and export of knowledge graphs from the browser without CLI/MCP calls
impact_assessment.risks: bounded within lattice/web.py 400-line budget and 0 inventory losses
impact_assessment.mitigation: use aikit ui verify and verify 100% test pass

[1/3] Design PRISMA 2020 systematic review screening and flow generator (lattice/screening.py)

impact_assessment.why: Enable researchers and agents to execute PRISMA 2020 systematic reviews with auditable screening decisions, structured exclusion reasons, and publication-ready vector SVG and Markdown flow diagrams
impact_assessment.benefits: Bridges exploratory knowledge graph navigation into rigorous systematic review synthesis adhering to academic PRISMA standards without third-party dependencies
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new screening table and PRISMA endpoints; dependency: none, standard library only; concurrency: atomic database writes; state: SQLite screening table
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit test coverage for state transitions, SVG validity, and CLI/API integration; record ADR-028

[1/3] Design token-bounded GraphRAG context pack engine

impact_assessment.why: Provide high-density, token-bounded GraphRAG context packs for LLM agents with deterministic quote anchors and provenance
impact_assessment.benefits: Enables downstream RAG and reasoning agents to inject relevant question-claim-paper subgraphs with strict token budget enforcement
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new context pack API/MCP tool; dependency: none, standard library only; concurrency: thread-safe read-only repository; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Token budget verification, unit test coverage, ADR-029 recording
